assessments.mechanism: Audit complete scientific artifacts—trace logs plus code/results—not just the final manuscript.
assessments.clean_scope: Controlled scientist-agent audit evidence; strongest support is for failure detection, not direct proof that online auditing improves discovery.
assessments.o_comparison: O already records detailed tool/invocation events and treats final self-reports/repository-authored review as insufficient; its scientist baseline explicitly records AI Scientist code/data integrity failures. It has not run the cited paper-only versus trace+code detection comparison or an online scientific-audit intervention.

assessments.mechanism: Best-first/tree-based parallel experimentation with checkpoint inheritance instead of one-shot or purely sequential research.
assessments.clean_scope: AIRS-Bench/AI Scientist-v2 evidence on executable ML research; scaffold/model/budget effects remain partly confounded.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly knows this AI Scientist-v2 mechanism and ran a scoped adaptation: width-1 single-lineage versus width-3 sibling checkpoints on three frozen tasks. That exact adaptation was rejected because invocations tripled while median wall time improved only 0.827209s. O's record expressly says this is not evidence against the original method, scientist-agent family, or untested mechanisms.

assessments.mechanism: Externalize scientific method selection into an explicit inspectable planning stage before execution.
assessments.clean_scope: ASI-Bench/ResearchClawBench diagnose a large method/protocol guidance bottleneck; they do not identify one proven planner implementation.
assessments.o_comparison: O already has an inspectable Root/strategy layer that selects one falsifiable unit and explicitly reconsider methods under saturation. It has not evaluated scientific-method selection under ASI-Bench guidance withdrawal or implemented the candidate planner as such.

assessments.mechanism: Verify protocol-to-execution-to-evidence consistency so manuscript claims are backed by actually executed experiments.
assessments.clean_scope: Mechanism is derived from multiple scientist-agent failure analyses; a clean randomized online-verifier ablation was not found.
assessments.o_comparison: O already binds requests, artifacts, outcomes, source digests, exact-head observations and evidence provenance, and fails closed on mismatches. It has not built/evaluated a scientific protocol-to-paper consistency verifier over agent research traces.

assessments.mechanism: Premise-validity/adversarial scientific-alignment gate before autonomous research invests in experiments and writing.
assessments.clean_scope: PseudoBench adversarial pseudoscience setting; supports a failure mode, not a demonstrated mitigation.
assessments.o_comparison: No dedicated premise-validity gate or PseudoBench-like resistance evaluation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Agentic self-challenging task/data generation with weak/strong discrimination and outer-loop meta-optimization.
assessments.clean_scope: Autodata synthetic-data/task-generation domain; transfer to end-to-end scientific method/experiment integrity is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: O has runtime-generated held-out tasks, bounded behavior-frontier/self-improvement machinery, and strategy-driven heterogeneous exploration, but no verified Autodata-style weak/strong discriminator plus prompt/meta-optimization loop. Only adjacent components have been exercised.

assessments.mechanism: Dedicated iterative deep/wide scientific-literature discovery subsystem.
assessments.clean_scope: AutoResearchBench establishes literature-discovery difficulty but does not itself demonstrate a high-performing mechanism.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly directs heterogeneous external scientific search and recognizes scientist-agent literature comparison as necessary. No dedicated literature-discovery subsystem or AutoResearchBench evaluation was found.

assessments.mechanism: Tournament/debate/evolve hypothesis generation with scaled test-time compute.
assessments.clean_scope: AI co-scientist biomedical/hypothesis setting; Elo is self-evaluated and independent matched-budget causal isolation is missing.
assessments.o_comparison: No tournament/debate/evolve hypothesis engine or matched-budget evaluation was found in O.
